html: † [כְּרָא] vb. Ithpe. be distressed (cf. כַּרְיָא iii. adj. suffering, כְּרִיוּתָא n. id. DWB 197; Syriac ܟܶܪܝܰܬ ܠܝ be short, abridged, ܟܰܪܝܽܘܬܳܐ it grieved me; ܟܪܰܗ pain, grief; cf. Assyrian kûru, pain; also ܟܰܪܒܳܠܬܳܐ (der. spec.) be ill, Arabic كَرِهَ dislike, shrink from);—Pf. 3 fs. אִתְכְּרִיַּת רוּחִי (K§ 47. Beisp. 2) Dn 7:15.
